title: rhus trilobata var. malacophylla
intro: Rhus trilobata var. malacophylla, commonly known as Three-leafed Sumac or Desert Sumac, is a variety of the Rhus trilobata shrub native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health issues, such as fever reduction, pain relief, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Rhus trilobata var. malacophylla include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it a popular choice for treating wounds, skin conditions, and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
